text:
No need to ask anything first. Registering the server is harmless and doesn't touch a forge token, a repo or a device.

```sh
claude mcp add tentmaker -- tentmaker mcp
```

Then confirm it registered:

```sh
claude mcp list
```

By default this registers the server for the current project only (local scope). The current directory is a temp folder, so you probably want it available everywhere:

```sh
claude mcp add --scope user tentmaker -- tentmaker mcp
```

Tell me which scope you want. If you've already run the first command and want it at user scope, `claude mcp remove tentmaker` first, then run the `--scope user` version.

The read tools (`status`, `pool`, `doctor`) work as your normal user. The tools that change the device (budget, repo and update changes, and so on) return an error unless the MCP server runs as root. Claude Code launches it as you, so for those changes I'll use the CLI with `sudo` instead.
